# Billing Research Note 1

Prior research on comparable products shows billing handling of subscription interacts with currency; teams noted that gateway depends on proration and discount, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm billing handling of arrears interacts with creditnote; teams noted that dunning depends on refund and settlement, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that billing handling of reconciliation interacts with installment; teams noted that payment depends on invoiceline and payout, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that billing handling of surcharge interacts with ledger; teams noted that writeoff depends on receipt and invoice, especially under real production load.
